summary: Sprint-closure QA complete for CR-033 (Audience Filters BUG-A fix), CR-034 (Customer Tags), CR-037 (Template Status Sync fix). 14/14 backend tests PASSED (serial run) and frontend UI smoke PASSED for the critical surfaces: Create Audience dialog renders all 5 accordion sections with correct default open/collapsed state, Customers page shows working '+ tag' buttons on every row and existing tag chips render correctly, Marketing → Audiences navigation works, tag catalog (VIP + QA-Tag-*) is populated. CR-037 status-sync guard verified end-to-end against a real preprod custom_templates doc (forced rejected → sync called → status stayed rejected → reverted).

critical_code_review_comments: GOOD: CR-037 backend fix at whatsapp.py:720-737 is minimally invasive — projection now includes `status`, guard only skips overwrite when current is 'rejected', authkey_wid is still back-filled unconditionally (so owner can fix + resubmit rejected templates without breaking WID discovery).

GOOD: CR-033 build_customer_query (core/helpers.py:322-352) — the 6 BUG-A filters (vip_flag, whatsapp_opt_in, has_birthday_this_month, is_blocked, blacklist_flag, complaint_flag) are all wired with an explicit `!= 'all'` guard and a proper truthy coercion. Regression test on preprod DB shows they no longer silently pass through.
GOOD: CR-034 tag endpoints use $addToSet (idempotent) on both customers.tags and users.available_tags, correct 30-char + regex validation.

MINOR: /app/backend/routers/customers.py is now ~2262 lines — code-review guideline says >700 should be split. Segments router + CR-034 tag endpoints + CR-035 import/export are all bundled here. Suggest extracting to customer_tags.py, customer_segments.py, customer_import_export.py. NON-BLOCKING for this sprint.

MINOR: The class-scoped fixture `sample_customer_id` in test file triggers a PytestRemovedIn10Warning. If you plan to keep this file long-term, convert to @classmethod or use @pytest.fixture(scope='class') at module level. Cosmetic only — tests still pass.

OBSERVATION: CAFE 103 tenant currently has 0 vip_flag=True customers (out of 337). The CR-034 VIP-auto-backfill migration would have had nothing to tag for this tenant. For QA parity with the smoke-test guide (which promises '≥2 VIPs after backfill'), the guide's phrasing should be tenant-agnostic ('all vip_flag=True customers were tagged with VIP', which may be 0 for some tenants). Not a code bug.
